title: DiagnosticIQ: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Industrial Maintenance Action Recommendation from Symbolic Rules
abstract: arXiv:2605.08614v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Monitoring complex industrial assets relies on engineer-authored symbolic rules that trigger on sensor conditions and prompt technicians to perform corrective actions. The bottleneck is not detection but response: translating rules into maintenance steps requires asset-specific knowledge gained through years of practice. We investigate whether LLMs can serve as decision support for this rule-to-action step and introduce \ours{}, a benchmark of 6{,}690 multiple-choice questions generated from 118 expert-authored rule-action pairs across 16 asset types, with experts reviewing the generated prompts for layout and conversational flow. translated_title: DiagnosticIQ：基于符号规则的大语言模型工业维护行动推荐基准
translated_abstract: 监控复杂的工业资产依赖于工程师编写的符号规则，这些规则在传感器条件触发时提示技术人员执行纠正措施。瓶颈不在于检测，而在于响应：将规则转化为维护步骤需要通过多年实践积累的资产特定知识。我们研究大语言模型（LLM）能否在这一“规则到行动”的步骤中充当决策支持，并提出了DiagnosticIQ基准，该基准包含从16种资产类型的118对专家编写的规则-行动对生成的6,690道多项选择题，专家还对生成提示的布局和对话流程进行了审查。我们的贡献包括：(i) 一个从符号规则到多项选择题（MCQA）的流水线，将规则规范化为析取范式并进行基于嵌入的干扰项采样；(ii) 五个探测不同失败模式的变体（Pro、Pert、Verbose、Aug、Rationale）；(iii) 一个涵盖29个大语言模型和4个嵌入基线的基准测试。一项由9名从业者参与的人类评估（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出DiagnosticIQ基准，通过符号规则到多项选择题的自动生成流水线构建了6,690道题目，系统评估大语言模型在工业维护中从专家规则推荐行动步骤的能力，涵盖29个LLM和4个嵌入基线的对比。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DiagnosticIQ, a benchmark of 6,690 multiple-choice questions generated from expert-authored symbolic rules via a symbolic-to-MCQA pipeline, to systematically evaluate LLMs' ability to recommend industrial maintenance actions across 29 LLMs and 4 embedding baselines.
